title: FrontRow: mark the Supabase service key as secret
_note: Follow-up to set-supabase-service-key (2026-11-07). Netlify then hides the value in the UI, API and CLI and scans build output for it; LIVEKIT_API_KEY on this site is already secret, so the plan supports it. The value does not change, so no redeploy is needed. Prefill opens the Edit form the same way as set-supabase-service-key; Mike ticks the box and saves. Run with --tab <Netlify tab>.

steps.instruction: Click Save variable. If Netlify asks you to confirm, confirm.
